instructions: For each icon, combine style_prefix + subject + style_suffix and paste into CLIPTextEncode. Set all five SaveImage basenames to the exact icon key. One icon per queue. Resource keys use the 48px output; ability keys use 380px, 144px and 64px outputs.
style_prefix: A single fantasy RPG ability icon:
style_suffix: . Original hand-painted game UI art, bold compact silhouette, engraved brass and dark steel, warm ivory highlights, restrained crimson accent, clean crisp edges. One centered emblem occupying 75 percent of the square canvas, generous empty margin, isolated on a flat solid charcoal background, no ground shadow. Symbolic icon, not a scene. No text, letters, numbers, watermark, border, frame, gradients in the background, modern firearms, or extra objects. Readable when reduced to 64 pixels.
resource_style_suffix: . A single simple fantasy RPG resource glyph, thick compact silhouette, engraved brass, dark steel and warm ivory highlights, clean crisp edges. One centered isolated emblem on a flat charcoal background with generous empty margin. No text, numbers, border, scenery, modern ammunition cartridges, tiny details or extra objects. Strong recognizable silhouette when reduced to 48 pixels.
